name: application-field-array-editor
title: Field Array Editor
description: A repeatable list of input rows with drag handles, per-row remove buttons, per-row validation, and an add-another affordance — for editable lists of values within a form.
useWhen: A form field represents a variable-length list of values — invite emails, URLs, phone numbers, custom key/value pairs.
Each row needs its own validation state and a reorder affordance, distinct from a single tag-input's inline chips.
avoidWhen: The list is small and unordered with simple string tokens — a `Tag Input` is lighter-weight for that case.
You need a fixed-length group of related fields (like a single address) rather than a repeatable, addable/removable list — use `form-row` composed directly instead.
responsiveBehavior: Rows stack vertically at all widths; the drag handle and remove button stay fixed-width so the input can shrink first on narrow viewports.
accessibility: The drag handle is a real button with an aria-label ("Drag to reorder"), not a bare icon, so it's reachable and nameable without a pointer.
Each row's remove button carries an aria-label ("Remove") since its icon alone has no accessible name.
A row's error message is linked to its input via aria-describedby and the input carries aria-invalid="true" when invalid.

variants.title: Email list
variants.description: Three repeatable email rows with drag handles and remove buttons; the third row shows an inline validation error.
accessibility: The invalid row's input carries aria-invalid and aria-describedby pointing at its error text.

variants.title: Email list (Dark)
variants.description: Email list field array adapted for dark surfaces, including the error-state border and text color.
accessibility: The error border and error text both meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark input and page background.
